name: KinglyVault Connect
description: Connect this InfiniBot to your KinglyVault account over an outbound relay (no open ports, works behind NAT/VPN/Tailscale). KinglyVault can then chat with your agents, start coders in folders you allow and guide you in your InfiniBot UI, all scoped, audited and revocable.

autoStart.description: Keep the KinglyVault link open while the gateway runs (default true once paired).
